# v26.0 WP10: Register existing Georgia/Arabia movements on load.
# Generated by gen_v260_cul_rel_overhaul.py; edit the generator, not this file.
on_game_start = { on_actions = { oe_eastern_identity_register_existing } }

oe_eastern_identity_register_existing = {
    trigger = { current_year >= 1200 }
    effect = {
        culture:oe_georgian_greek_culture = {
            oe_identity_adopt_existing_start = { movement = oe_georgia_identity_movement }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_identity_fixed_30y_scheduled } any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_georgia_identity_movement } }
                oe_identity_schedule_30_years = { holder = culture:oe_georgian_greek_culture event = oe_eastern_identity.1 }
            }
        }
        culture:oe_arabian_greek_culture = {
            oe_identity_adopt_existing_start = { movement = oe_arabia_identity_movement }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_identity_fixed_30y_scheduled } any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_arabia_identity_movement } }
                oe_identity_schedule_30_years = { holder = culture:oe_arabian_greek_culture event = oe_eastern_identity.2 }
            }
        }
    }
}
